description: Look up ntfy emoji tag short codes. Use the returned `tag` strings in `ntfy_publish_message`'s `tags` field to render emojis on the recipient's device. Without a query, returns the first slice of the full reference; pass a substring (e.g., `warning`, `tada`, `cd`) to filter, and `offset` to page through matches beyond `limit`.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Default 25, max 200.

offset.description: Number of matches to skip before returning `limit` rows. Use it with `totalCount` to page past the `limit` cap — the reference holds far more tags than one call can return.

query.description: Substring to match against emoji tag names (case-insensitive). Omit to list the reference from the start in its documented order.

name: ntfy_search_emoji_tags

effectiveQuery.description: The query as the server parsed it; absent when no query was given.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matches.description: Tag → emoji rows in the order they appear in the upstream reference.

tag.description: Emoji short code — pass this verbatim in `ntfy_publish_message`'s `tags` field.

notice.description: Guidance when no tags matched or matches remain unseen — echoes the query and names the next `offset` or a shorter substring.

truncated.description: True when matches remain past this page — advance with `offset` to reach them.

title: Ntfy Search Emoji Tags
